snippet.title: Creepy Shift: Uncle Joe's Motel - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Vol. 3 of the 'CREEPY SHIFT' series based on bloody creepypastas.😈
► Full game drops March 4  
► Free demo available to download: Feb 23 – Mar 2👇
► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3734400/Creepy_Shift_Uncle_Joes_Motel/

HOW IT WORKS:
► Take a night shift at a roadside motel.
► Do all your duties.
► Uncover the place’s dark secrets. 
► Try to survive until dawn.

JOIN US:
► Discord: https://discord.gg/WWVrsEsXhz
► Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/RedLimbStudio  
► X: https://x.com/333Creepyshift

"My footsteps thundered down the hallway as she fled from the woman, trying each door as she passed only to find them all locked. She didn’t have time to check if my key worked. She still didn’t know if any of this was real, or some kind of twisted nightmare."
